sn48.50:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati āpaṇannāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.
sn48.50:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ āmantesi
sn48.50:1.4: yo so sārīputta ariyasāvako tathāgate ekantagato abhippasanno na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vāti.
sn48.50:2.1: yo so bhante ariyasāvako tathāgate ekantagato abhippasanno na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā.
sn48.50:2.2: saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ āraddhaviriyo viharissati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
sn48.50:3.1: saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa eta pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ satimā bhavissati paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
sn48.50:3.2: yā hissa bhante sati tadassa satindriyaṃ.
sn48.50:4.1: saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhiṃ labhissati cittassa ekaggataṃ.
sn48.50:4.2: yo hissa bhante samādhi tadassa samādhindriyaṃ.
sn48.50:5.1: saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino sammāsamāhitacittassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ evaṃ pajānissati
sn48.50:5.3: pubbā koṭi nappaññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ
sn48.50:5.4: avijjāya tveva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho santametaṃ padaṃ paṇītametaṃ padaṃ yadidaṃ
sn48.50:5.5: sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
sn48.50:5.6: yā hissa bhante paññā tadassa paññindriyaṃ.
sn48.50:6.1: sakho so bhante ariyasāvako evaṃ padahitvā padahitvā evaṃ saritvā saritvā evaṃ samādahitvā samādahitvā evaṃ pajānitvā pajānitvā evaṃ abhisaddahati
sn48.50:6.2: ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutāva ahesuṃ
sn48.50:6.3: tenāhaṃ etarahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi paññāya ca ativijjha passāmīti.
sn48.50:6.4: yā hissa bhante saddhā tadassa saddhindriyanti.
